environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2) with a public IP address. The instance security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no reverse proxy. The application listens directly on port 8080 and is reachable from the public internet. The container runs as a non-root user but has read access to /etc/passwd and other system files.
